source_summary: Tall ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with layered rounded mountains, misty waterways, pine groves, small pavilions, village roofs, bridges, and foreground rocky islands. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: towering_central_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant high mountain mass in the upper center-right: a steep rounded peak with nested vertical ridges, dark vegetation dots along crest lines, and pale mist-wash gaps between slopes.
must_preserve: arched hemp-fiber texture strokes running down the slopes
dense black tree-dot clusters along ridge tops
soft grey ink wash gradients on rounded faces
mist-softened lower edges where the mountain dissolves into the valley
asymmetrical peak silhouette leaning slightly right

motifs.name: misty_left_valley_water
motifs.description: Isolate the broad left middle valley with low distant hills, horizontal water bands, marshy banks, and atmospheric haze behind the nearer slopes.
must_preserve: faint layered hill contours fading into mist
thin horizontal ink lines marking water surfaces
soft blurred wash transitions at the horizon
small dark shrub and tree marks along the far bank
open negative-space mist separating hills from water

motifs.name: mountain_saddle_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and building group perched on the central-right mountain saddle, including the narrow terraces or path-like ledges around it.
must_preserve: fine angular roof geometry with dark ink rooflines
stacked terrace ledges cut into the mountain slope
tiny vertical wall strokes beneath roofs
surrounding cliff texture immediately supporting the buildings
misty wash around the saddle without including the large peak above

motifs.name: lower_left_hillside_temple
motifs.description: Isolate the compact temple or pavilion complex tucked into the lower-left hillside, framed by rounded rocks, vertical trunks, and a sloping mountain shoulder.
must_preserve: tiered roof outlines with upturned eaves
slender vertical tree trunks beside the structures
dark stippled foliage clusters on the enclosing hill
rounded rock contours with dry-brush texture
small platform and wall lines beneath the roofs

motifs.name: central_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central grove of straight pines rising from the lower middle hills, with clustered trunks, needle crowns, and rounded bouldery mounds at their base.
must_preserve: long thin vertical pine trunks
dark fanlike and clustered needle marks
varied tree heights creating an uneven canopy
ink-dot undergrowth along the ground line
rounded hill and boulder washes supporting the grove

motifs.name: lower_left_waterside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the waterside village cluster in the lower left-center: several low houses with pale walls and dark roofs set along a bank beside calm water.
must_preserve: crisp low roof geometry and overlapping gables
thin wall and fence lines
dark shrub dots around the buildings
flat horizontal waterline just below the bank
subtle light wash defining the open clearing

motifs.name: right_valley_bridge_and_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-right valley passage with the arched bridge, narrow stream, path, and adjacent small banks between rounded hills.
must_preserve: arched bridge curve with thin vertical support strokes
narrow winding stream edges
small path lines leading toward the bridge
rounded hill washes on both sides
dark shrub accents at the bank edges

motifs.name: foreground_right_pine_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground right rocky promontory with tall dark pines, a small hut or pavilion on the ledge, and boulders descending into water.
must_preserve: bold dark pine trunks and dense needle masses
small simple roofed structure partly hidden among trees
rounded foreground boulders with dark outline accents
stippled moss and shrub dots along the ridge
horizontal water strokes at the promontory base

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
